question: Hversu margar stofnanir eru í gögnunum?
Hversu marga reikninga greiddi ríkið 30. desember 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice WHERE payment_date = '2025-12-30'

question: Hver var stærsti birgir Veðurstofunnar árið 2025 og hvað fékk hann mikið greitt?
reference_sql: SELECT v.name, SUM(l.amount) AS s FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id WHERE b.name = 'Veðurstofa Íslands' GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

question: Hvaða birgir fékk mest greitt frá ríkinu á árinu 2025, og hversu mikið?
reference_sql: SELECT v.name, SUM(l.amount) AS s FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id GROUP BY v.id ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

question: Hvað greiddi Háskóli Íslands mikið í húsaleigu árið 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id JOIN cost_type t ON t.id = l.cost_type_id WHERE b.name = 'Háskóli Íslands' AND t.name = 'Húsaleiga'

question: Frá hversu mörgum stofnunum fékk Advania greitt árið 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.buyer_id) FROM invoice i JOIN vendor v ON v.id = i.vendor_id WHERE v.name = 'Advania Ísland ehf.'

question: Hvaða stofnanir greiddu enga reikninga í desember 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT b.name FROM buyer b LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT buyer_id FROM invoice WHERE payment_date >= '2025-12-01') d ON d.buyer_id = b.id WHERE d.buyer_id IS NULL

question: Hvað greiddi Landspítalinn mikið í október 2025?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM invoice_line l JOIN invoice i ON i.id = l.invoice_id JOIN buyer b ON b.id = i.buyer_id WHERE b.name = 'Landspítali' AND substr(i.payment_date, 1, 7) = '2025-10'

question: Hversu margir reikningar voru greiddir á fleiri en einum degi, það er sami kaupandi, birgir og reikningsnúmer með fleiri en eina greiðsludagsetningu?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM invoice GROUP BY buyer_id, vendor_id, invoice_number HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_date) > 1)
